announcements.title: B.Tech III Year I Sem Mid-II Examinations Timetable Released
announcements.author: Examination Branch, CVRCE
announcements.body: Mid-II examinations for B.Tech III Year I Semester will commence from November 24, 2026. Hall tickets can be downloaded starting Nov 18.

announcements.title: CIENCIA 2026 — Annual Technical Symposium
announcements.author: Student Affairs, CVRCE
announcements.body: CVR College of Engineering presents CIENCIA 2026 featuring Project Expo, Web-A-Thon, and Code Wars. Registrations are open at C-Block foyer.
